scope.abstract_novelty: this strengthens a known finite-volume H11/29 polytope carrier; it does not claim a new abstract Coxeter polytope

scope.square_minus_four: the twelve (-4,div2) reflection vectors are archived without an effectivity or irreducible-curve claim

Roulleau_complete_nef_stock.primary_reference: Xavier Roulleau, An atlas of K3 surfaces with finite automorphism group, EPIGA 6 (2022), article 19

theorem: After the exact positive marking and an 87-reflection Weyl transport, the complex A16 H11/29 carrier lies in Roulleau's complete closed nef chamber on NS=U+D8(-1)+A1(-1)^2.  All seventeen transported (-2) orientations are effective: facet 23 is the irreducible curve A16 and the other sixteen are explicit reducible divisors.  The twelve (-4,div2) vectors remain separate.  H+D136 is a primitive square-44258 ample class strict on all twenty-nine imported walls.
